C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4.IntentSummary:
Reconcile the two test pins that C-PAYMENT-RECORD-3's performed record work left stale, and add the three production invariant assertions the approved spec's suite-shaped criteria lean on — nothing else. This bundle performs no record write: no row insert, no retirement move against the production record, no staged-entry flush, no hand-stamped PaidBy; the record under docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/ is read and verified, never written. The work is one task, T-001, writing exactly three files — src/artifact/xml.test.ts, scripts/fixtures/record-parse/baseline-probes.json, and scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts — and ObservedWriteScope names exactly those three. DurableScope is <M-GRAMMAR /> alone, the C-RECORD-PARSE precedent (.ngrace/changes/archive/C-RECORD-PARSE/plan.xml:153-163 anchored the same class of files with the same lone anchor and the gates accepted it); do not mint a synthetic module and do not add a second anchor. The ordering rule (F204, ordering and instrument halves) is structural here: T-001 is the only task and every suite-shaped CloseEvidence in the spec is measured at close, after its writer. Every number below is already measured and lives in the approved spec; this plan re-derives none of it and re-measures only where a task says so at execution.
The two stale pins, reconciled to the measured post-payment state: (1) src/artifact/xml.test.ts's production element-count table — findings.xml 213 → 195, findings-retired.xml 58 → 77, registry-retired.xml 36 → 44, decisions.xml 337 → 338; rulings.xml 61, rulings-retired.xml 5 and registry.xml 12 are unchanged and stay as pinned; (2) scripts/fixtures/record-parse/baseline-probes.json's payerMapBaseline sub-object, regenerated wholesale from the shipped derivation: import the shipped derivePayerMap (scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:403) and feed it the direct Row children of both registry layers whose kind is chartered or historical, at the commit read from git rev-parse HEAD at capture time — the F212 method: the shipped function over the real record and real archive, never a re-derivation. The regenerated sub-object keeps its field set with each field true of the new capture: rule text naming the capture commit, command, fullTokenCount 73, rowsOnlyTokenCount 73, proseOnlyRoutes [], rowRouteTokensNamedBySpec recomputed, map = the 73-token derivation (F152 and F43 absent, the nineteen row-derived tokens present with the payers the spec's pairing assigns). The top-level baseCommit, measured and engine fields and the falsePaymentProbe, equivalenceClassProbe and canFailDemonstrations branches stay untouched. (3) In scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts the assertions that pin payerMapBaseline's capture-time shape move with the fixture: proseOnlyRoutes to toEqual([]) (from toEqual(["F152", "F43"]) at :1892), the F152 and F43 map entries to toBeUndefined (from :1893-1894), and the stale comment at :1888-1890 updated to say 73 derived tokens captured post-payment — while the F152/F43 drop-out assertions in the payer-derivation test (:1818-1819) stay as live assertions and keep passing, and the top-level baseCommit literal and the falsePaymentProbe and equivalenceClassProbe captures stay untouched.
The three production invariant assertions, appended to scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts in the same change, each an invariant and never an occupancy count — no element total, token total, base value, or base-commit SHA goes into a new assertion: (a) the flush invariant, test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 flush invariant: f204 is exactly once and live in the production record" — the shipped parser and its exported walkNodes (src/artifact/xml.ts:233) walk findings.xml and decisions.xml and require exactly one Finding with id="f204" status="live" and exactly one Entry with id="f204" layer="live"; the walk over the whole tree is the no-duplicate check, because a second id="f204" anywhere in either tree makes the walk return two. (b) The roots invariants, test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 roots invariant: every live root satisfies base + headroom = ceiling and base equals its shipped metric read back" — for all four live roots (findings.xml, registry.xml, decisions.xml, rulings.xml), base + headroom = ceiling, and the base equals its shipped metric read back from the file: the shipped newlineCount export (scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:120, already imported by the test file) for the three line-budgeted genres; the live Row count for registry, read by the shipped liveRowCount rule (direct Row children whose status is not retired — scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:975) over the shipped parser. liveRowCount is not exported; mirror its rule over the shipped parser, do not export it, and do not add scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts to write scope. (c) The retired-layer invariant, test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 retired-layer invariant: every retired Finding carries a PaidBy that matches its derived payer and names an archive directory" — over every Finding in findings-retired.xml, parsed: the PaidBy child is present and non-empty; whenever the shipped derivePayerMap derives a payer for that token from the registry rows, the stored PaidBy equals it; and the stored PaidBy names an archive directory (the shipped listArchiveNames, :136). The equality stays conditional and must stay conditional: F43 and F152 carry PaidBy stamped by the removed prose pass (C-APPROVE-TIME-REVIEW, a real archive directory) for tokens the rows-only derivation no longer derives — 75 of 77 equal, 2 with no derived payer, measured; do not hard-code F43 or F152, and do not write an unconditional equality, which is false on the delivered record.
Why no suite command appears in any task Verification: the spec's evidence-hygiene Constraint (F184) requires every task Verification command to exit 0 as written at recording time, and the suite is red at recording time with exactly the two stale pins this bundle reconciles — measured at e0a3e6c, bun test src/artifact/xml.test.ts scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts exits 1. T-001's Criteria therefore instruct the executor to run the suite as part of the work — before any write, observe exactly the two named tests failing; after the writes, observe it green with the three new assertions among the passing — and the recorded Verification carries only commands that exit 0 at recording time and stay green. The suite-shaped formal evidence lives in TargetAssertions (evaluated at the target gate, after the writes) and in the spec's CloseEvidence criteria (evaluated at close, after the archive): the approve gate evaluates only unresolved IC-*/INV-* clarifications (src/gates/core.ts:290-322), so post-work Target facts are first evaluated at the target gate. F211's red window is declared and by design here too: the baseline MustContains pinning the stale pre-work state go false when T-001's writes land, so root lint mid-bundle reports assertion errors naming this plan until the archive; archived plans are evaluated syntax-only, so post-archive lint stays green, and the window is the assertion set working as designed — do not keep the stale pins to quiet it.
No record write, no record-freeze engagement: D30's freeze holds for record-writing tasks, and this bundle has none, so the freeze never engages and no brief promises a frozen base. Nothing in this plan writes or prunes .ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md; nothing runs --retire against the production record — the no-op property is probed on a throwaway copy only, by the recorded command. The ceiling-vs-base-commit comparison stays out of the suite: it is already wired as AC-ROOTS-CONSISTENT's second CloseEvidence Command and is recorded here only as a task Verification command that exits 0 at recording time and after the writes. The executor emits its own execution-time cursor events for its task (opened, progress, attempt, command-run) and does not omit them; the terminal event and the cursor fold are close acts owned by the authority, together with the --assertions final --run-commands gate, both gate verdicts, gate apply, the status="applied" write, gate archive, the git mv to .ngrace/changes/archive/, and the close's own record retirement move — a byte-level no-op here, because this bundle mints no charter row, so its name has no row for the close to move; no task performs any of them and no sentence in this plan implies execution does. Do not hand-write any status. Escape markup as character data (<, >, &) in every artifact this bundle writes; never paraphrase brackets away.

T-001.Title: Reconcile the two stale pins to the measured post-payment state and add the three production invariant assertions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: This task is the reconciliation and it is atomic: before any write, run bun test src/artifact/xml.test.ts scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts and observe exactly two failing tests — "C-RECORD-PARSE payer derivation: F152 and F43 drop out and every other token's payer is unchanged from the baseline map" and "pairs every element of the real record files at their committed bytes" — recording the tail in the run-ledger. If anything else is red, or if either stale pin is not stale in the way the spec's Goal 4 describes, stop and report; never edit a test pin to fit a record state the pins do not describe (D27). The suite transitions red to green inside this task; no recorded Verification command runs the suite, because the suite exits 1 as written at recording time (F184) and the spec's evidence-hygiene Constraint allows only the --assertions target --run-commands exception; the suite-shaped formal evidence is TargetAssertions (target gate, after the writes) and the spec's CloseEvidence criteria (close, after the archive). The write set is exactly three files — src/artifact/xml.test.ts, scripts/fixtures/record-parse/baseline-probes.json, and scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts — nothing else under src/ or scripts/, no record file, no engine file (do not export liveRowCount; mirror its rule over the shipped parser), no .ngrace-lint.json, no staged buffer, and nothing under .ngrace/changes/archive/ or docs/plans/archive/. The ceiling-vs-base-commit comparison stays out of the suite: it is AC-ROOTS-CONSISTENT's second CloseEvidence Command and is not re-implemented as a test.

src/artifact/xml.test.ts: in the production element-count table, change exactly four entries — findings.xml 213 to 195, findings-retired.xml 58 to 77, registry-retired.xml 36 to 44, decisions.xml 337 to 338 — and touch nothing else in the file: rulings.xml 61, rulings-retired.xml 5 and registry.xml 12 stay as pinned, and no other test, helper or import in the file changes.

scripts/fixtures/record-parse/baseline-probes.json: regenerate only the payerMapBaseline sub-object, by importing the shipped derivePayerMap over the production registry layers at the commit git rev-parse HEAD reports at capture time (read it at execution; never copy a commit from this plan into the fixture), feeding it the direct Row children of both registry layers whose kind is chartered or historical. The regenerated sub-object keeps its field set with each field true of the new capture: rule text naming the capture commit and saying the shipped function ran over the real record and real archive; command; fullTokenCount 73; rowsOnlyTokenCount 73; proseOnlyRoutes empty; the nineteen row-derived tokens present in map with the payers the spec's pairing assigns and F152 and F43 absent; rowRouteTokensNamedBySpec recomputed true of the capture. The top-level baseCommit, measured and engine fields and the falsePaymentProbe, equivalenceClassProbe and canFailDemonstrations branches stay byte-untouched. Preserve the file's formatting conventions; a projection is never written — the map is the derivation's output, read from the shipped function's return.

scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts: move the payerMapBaseline-shape assertions to match the regenerated fixture — proseOnlyRoutes to toEqual([]) (from toEqual(["F152", "F43"]) at :1892), the F152 and F43 map entries to toBeUndefined (from toBe("C-APPROVE-TIME-REVIEW") at :1893-1894), and the stale comment at :1888-1890 updated to say 73 derived tokens captured post-payment — and leave the F152/F43 drop-out assertions at :1818-1819, the fullTokenCount self-consistency at :1891, the five named map entries, the falsePaymentProbe and equivalenceClassProbe assertions, and the top-level baseCommit literal untouched. Then append three production invariant assertions, each an invariant and never an occupancy count — no element total, token total, base value, or base-commit SHA in any of them: (a) test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 flush invariant: f204 is exactly once and live in the production record" — parse findings.xml and decisions.xml with the shipped parseGraceXmlArtifact, walk every node with the exported walkNodes (src/artifact/xml.ts:233), and require exactly one Finding with id="f204" whose status is live and exactly one Entry with id="f204" whose layer is live; the walk over the whole tree is the no-duplicate check; (b) test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 roots invariant: every live root satisfies base + headroom = ceiling and base equals its shipped metric read back" — for findings.xml, registry.xml, decisions.xml and rulings.xml, parse the root, require base + headroom = ceiling, and require the base to equal the shipped metric read back from the file: the exported newlineCount (already imported by the test file) for the three line-budgeted genres, and for registry the live Row count read by the shipped liveRowCount rule (direct Row children whose status is not retired — scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:975) over the shipped parser, because liveRowCount is not exported and must not be; (c) test name exactly "C-PAYMENT-RECORD-4 retired-layer invariant: every retired Finding carries a PaidBy that matches its derived payer and names an archive directory" — over every Finding element in findings-retired.xml, parsed: the PaidBy child is present and non-empty; whenever the shipped derivePayerMap derives a payer for that token from the registry rows (both layers, kind chartered or historical, gated on archive membership — the same collection the payer-derivation test builds), the stored PaidBy equals it; and the stored PaidBy names an archive directory via the shipped listArchiveNames (:136). The equality stays conditional and must stay conditional: F43 and F152 carry PaidBy=C-APPROVE-TIME-REVIEW, a real archive directory, for tokens the rows-only derivation does not derive — do not hard-code either token, do not special-case them by name, and do not write an unconditional equality. Give all three tests an explicit generous timeout (F185) as the production-reading tests in this file already carry.
